Finite tests corroborate, do not replace, the infinite proof. Cross-component distances are undefined.

value.rationale: For the canonical graph formed by two matched cliques the full optimal-state configuration space is a natural, exact network relocation invariant. Keeping optimal standard forcing while moving one monitor across an actual graph edge changes every full-layer universal TJ hub into an isolated TS state; two remaining components have a sharp diameter three, unique antipodes and exact shortest route multiplicities for all n>=4. These illuminate a meaningful movement-policy obstruction and are not simply a routine recomputation of the already-known optimum count.
